content.short: Titan is a TON DEX aggregator and DeFi stack for low-fee swaps, routing, APIs, and concentrated liquidity.
content.description: Titan is a DeFi stack for swaps and liquidity on TON. TON App describes it as a DEX aggregator with best-priced swaps, zero fees, developer API toolkits, and concentrated liquidity for LPs. It is aimed at traders who want efficient TON token execution and at builders who want to add swap functionality to apps. Titan Dex is included because users can take a concrete financial action there, not only read about a token. Titan Dex is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
